data: Which of the following BioASQ test sets had the lowest average micro f-measure?

To determine which BioASQ test set had the lowest average micro f-measure, I will analyze the graph and compare the positions of the green lines representing the average micro f-measure across all participating systems. The lower the position of the green line, the lower the average micro f-measure.

From the graph, I can see that the green line for BioASQ7 is positioned at the lowest point among all the test sets. This indicates that BioASQ7 had the lowest average micro f-measure.
